ExchangeType.description:
Structure of a distressed exchange offer.

The variant records how the new instrument ranks against the existing claim
and is reported back on [`ExchangeOfferAnalysis`] for audit purposes; it
does not change the arithmetic.

oneOf.description: New instrument issued at the same face amount as the old claim.
New instrument issued at a face amount below the old claim.
Participating creditors are lifted above the existing capital structure.
Participating creditors are subordinated relative to their old claim.

description: Hold-versus-tender economics of a distressed exchange offer.

breakeven_recovery.description:
Hold-out recovery, as a fraction of the existing claim's present value,
at which tendering and holding out break even. Capped at `1.0`.

delta_npv.description: Tender consideration less the hold-out present value.

equity_sweetener_value.description: Estimated value of attached equity or warrants.

exchange_type.description: Structure of the offer, echoed back in canonical form.

new_npv.description: Present value of the new instrument received on tendering.

old_npv.description: Present value of the existing claim if the holder does not tender.

tender_recommended.description:
Whether the tender consideration clears the
[`TENDER_RECOMMENDATION_HURDLE`] cushion over the hold-out value.

tender_total.description: Total tender consideration: new instrument plus fee plus sweetener.

title: ExchangeOfferAnalysis
